messages:
maria_gonzalez: Heads up — Stewart Logistics dropped from ~18k calls/day to ~2k yesterday. Usage dashboard shows an 88% fall. Could be config or token change. @aj_patel can you confirm sales/procurement outreach?
aj_patel: Yep, procurement mentioned they're running a competitor pilot next week. Haven't heard from Devon (customer) since Dec. I left a voicemail this morning.
leo_hart: I'll pull runtime logs and KV/cache metrics now. Quick glance shows a config change on 2026-03-18 by steward-sre; might be related. Running a quick health probe: 
leo_hart: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/stewart
```
devon_chu: Confirming from our side — we did a small internal key rotation for staging only. Prod keys unchanged. Procurement is asking for QPS SLA and clarity on token expiry. Also flagged some latency blips in Feb that worried their SREs.
maria_gonzalez: Okay — two objectives: (1) fix immediate friction so calls resume, (2) prevent churn by addressing procurement concerns and the competitor pilot. Proposed next steps below.
aj_patel: sounds good. I'll offer a commercial package: 90-day dedicated pilot discount + quarterly review. Need enablement deck and SLA addendum to attach.
leo_hart: From infra side — they disabled KV cache and set batch_size very low in the agent config; that explains higher costs earlier and the sudden drop (they throttled client retries). I can prepare a one-click config patch to re-enable cache and recommended batch settings.
maria_gonzalez: @devon_chu can we share the enterprise SLA addendum with them? Procurement asked for it explicitly.
devon_chu: Yes, ok to share the EAA. Please remove any internal notes.
ops-bot: Incident detected: config-change by steward-sre at 2026-03-18 22:13 UTC — rollback available.
maria_gonzalez: Let's coordinate rollback + outreach. @aj_patel please schedule renewal sync with procurement and their new eng lead (Rohan). We should position the patch as an immediate mitigation and the pilot offer as the retention play.
aj_patel: Penciled for Thurs 10am PT, invite sent to procurement + Rohan + Devon.
leo_hart: I'll prepare a config patch and join the call. Will also attach a short runbook on KV cache and batching.
maria_gonzalez: Capturing feedback: procurement cares about predictable costs and SLA terms; SRE wants clear docs on cache and token lifecycle. I'll draft a concise playbook and loop in #eng-runtime for a quick review.
maria_gonzalez: Actions recap — leo: patch + logs by EOD; aj: renewal invite + commercial offer; devon: SLA doc share (redacted); maria: health-check invite + playbook draft.
aj_patel: :thumbsup:
devon_chu: Thanks all, appreciate the quick response.
maria_gonzalez: I'll follow up in thread with artifacts (deck, SLA, patch link).
